title: The Most Valuable Buffalo Bills Cards Ever Sold, Ranked (Bills Mafia Grails)
summary: Discover the most valuable Buffalo Bills cards ever sold, from Josh Allen's record $1.7M rookie card to Jim Kelly and Bruce Smith grails. Full rankings inside.
body_markdown:
On November 1st, 2021,[Buffalo Bills](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Buffalo%20Bills) quarterback[Josh Allen](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Josh%20Allen&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) told[the Manning Cast](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/josh-allen-says-hell-join-bills-mafia-by-jumping-off-a-bus-and-through-a-table-if-buffalo-wins-super-bowl/) that he wouldn’t jump through a folding table until the Bills won the Super Bowl. Meanwhile, Bills Mafia, the nickname given to Bills fans across Western New York and[throughout the globe](https://www.instagram.com/reels/DdHNxbAio_1/) , have been[smashing tables for years](https://www.si.com/onsi/athlete-lifestyle/news/why-do-buffalo-bills-fans-break-tables) . The franchise continues to be haunted by both[Patrick Mahomes](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Patrick%20Mahomes&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) and “[wide right!](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wide_Right_(Buffalo_Bills)) ”, but that hasn’t dissuaded fans or collectors alike from chasing the charismatic QB.


In fact, the most expensive Buffalo Bills card ever sold is Josh Allen’s 2018 Rookie Patch Auto Platinum Shield 1/1 (PSA 8.5), which sold privately in 2026 for a record $1.7 million. Not only that, but Josh Allen holds all five of the highest verified sales for any Buffalo Bills cards in history.


Rank Card Name Year Grade Record Sale


1[Josh Allen](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Josh%20Allen&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) National Treasures Rookie Patch Auto Platinum NFL Shield 1/1 2018 PSA 8.5 $1.7M


2 Josh Allen Topps Chrome Honors MVP Gold NFL Shield Auto 1/1 2025 Ungraded $1.35M


3 Josh Allen National Treasures Rookie Patch Auto Holo Gold /10 2018 PSA 10 $288,000


4 Josh Allen Prizm Gold Vinyl /5 2018 Not reported $264,000


5 Josh Allen National Treasures Red Rookie Patch Auto 1/1 2018 Not reported $240,000


Naturally, the most valuable[Buffalo Bills cards](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Buffalo%20Bills) ever sold all belong to none other than Josh Allen himself. Not Hall of Famer[Jim Kelly](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Jim%20Kelly&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , who famously led the team to four-straight Super Bowls, or his famous defensive teammate[Bruce Smith](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Bruce%20Smith&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) ; not even the one and only[O.J. Simpson](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=O.J.%20Simpson&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , can dethrone Allen’s aura.


His 2018 National Treasures Rookie Patch Auto Platinum NFL Shield 1/1 (PSA 8.5) sold privately for a record $1.7 million on August 6th, 2026, and is followed by similar rookie cards: a $1.35M Topps Chrome Honors MVP Shield 1/1 Josh Allen Rookie Card, a $288,000 Holo Gold /10 Josh Allen Rookie Card, a $264,000 Prizm Gold Vinyl /5 Josh Allen Rookie Card, and a $240,000 Red Rookie Patch Auto 1/1 Josh Allen Rookie Card.


The $1.7 million sale makes Allen one of only five NFL players—fellow quarterbacks[Tom Brady](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Tom%20Brady&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , Patrick Mahomes,[Justin Herbert](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Justin%20Herbert&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) (yikes), and[Joe Burrow](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Joe%20Burrow&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) —that have two or more $1 million card sales. Of those five, he’s one of the three without a Super Bowl ring, something he’s desperately trying to change.


Clearly, Bills fans and collectors alike believer (or Billieve), as our[2026 NFL Card List](https://courtyard.io/blog/post/blog-post-2026-nfl-card-tier-list-popular-football-cards?d565656f_page=1) , which uses collector data to chart the most popular football cards to collect on Courtyard, features Allen as one of just three S-Tier players, meaning collectors on[Courtyard.io](http://courtyard.io/) that pull a Josh Allen keep the card more than they do for nearly any other player on the platform.


Below is a list featuring the most expensive cards featuring a Bills legend, either in a Bills jersey or the jersey of a team they played for before or after their time in Buffalo, ranked by the highest verified sale.


Now, for the moment you’ve all been waiting for: “[The Bills make me want to shout!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1JpeDWbgUO8) ”


Photo credit:[Alt](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/josh-allen-national-treasures-rookie-patch-autograph-11-sells-for-1-7-million-a-record-for-any-josh-allen-card-302845150.html)


## **The Top-5 Most Valuable Cards Featuring Buffalo Bills Legends:**


### **1. 2018 Panini National Treasures**[Josh Allen](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Josh%20Allen&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **Rookie Patch Auto #163 Platinum NFL Shield 1/1 (PSA 8.5) – $1.7 million**


The Platinum NFL Shield is the premier 1/1 version of Josh Allen’s flagship rookie card, and a PSA 8.5 copy changes hands in a private sale for $1.7 million, according to[Sports Illustrated](https://www.si.com/collectibles/josh-allen-rookie-card-new-record-private-deal) . It’s the highest price ever paid for a Bills card, and a fairly rare $1 million-plus sale for a NFL card.


Want to get your own piece of the Josh Allen card market?[Browse every Josh Allen card available on Courtyard’s marketplace](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Josh%20Allen&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , or take your shot at a Josh Allen grail—like the 2018 National Treasures Green Jersey Number Patch Auto /17 Rookie Card valued at $16,500—via our[digital Football packs](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=football) , which only feature[graded, authenticated cards](https://courtyard.io/blog/post/welcome-to-card-school-the-difference-between-slabbed-cards-and-their-raw-counterparts) so you can trust that[what you pull is legit](https://courtyard.io/blog/post/is-courtyard-io-legit-heres-what-you-need-to-know) .


### **2. 2025 Topps Chrome Honors MVP**[Josh Allen](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Josh%20Allen&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **Gold NFL Shield Auto 1/1 – $1.35 million**


This is the pull you wait your whole life for—and[three brothers hit the jackpot](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7300621/2026/05/22/josh-allen-gold-shield-card-record-sale/) early when they found the Topps Chrome Honors MVP pack their grandmother had purchased for them. The redemption card for Josh Allen’s Gold NFL Shield auto rookie card sold for $1.35 million in May of 2026.


### **3. 2018 Panini National Treasures**[Josh Allen](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Josh%20Allen&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **RPA Holo Gold #163 /10 – $288,000**


The Holo Gold parallel of Josh Allen’s 2018 Panini National Treasures Rookie Patch Auto Rookie Card is numbered to just 10 copies, and commanded $288,000 back in 2022. In the time since, Josh Allen won a MVP award. How high would the price push if he won a Super Bowl?


### **4. 2018 Panini Prizm**[Josh Allen](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Josh%20Allen&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **Gold Vinyl /5 – $264,000**


In 2020, this card sold for $7,000. In January of 2022, it sold for $264,000. Timing is everything.


### **5. 2018 Panini National Treasures**[Josh Allen](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Josh%20Allen&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **Red RPA 1/1 – $240,000**


January of 2022 was a big month for Josh Allen cards. While the team came up short against the Kansas City Chiefs in[the famous 13-second drive game](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/3_-r1I0i-EU) , Allen had two cards sell for more than $200,000, including this 1/1 rookie that went for $240,000. Talk about a grail!


## **The Best-Selling Bills Cards From the Rest of the Bills’ Roster**


Believe it or not, the Bills are a football team made up of 53 players. Josh Allen can’t do it all alone, and collectors have taken notice, buying up plenty of other Bills cards over the years. While none have topped the star QB, here are the runners up:


Photo credit:[Sports Card Investor](https://www.sportscardinvestor.com/cards/jim-kelly-football/1984-topps-usfl-base-36)


### **1984 Topps USFL**[Jim Kelly](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Jim%20Kelly&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **Rookie Card #36 (PSA 10) – $11,000**


The Hall of Fame quarterback’s all-time top sale is a PSA 10 rookie card from his USFL days, back before he joined the Bills—the team he’d later try to buy in an attempt to keep them from leaving town. The card went for $11,000 in February of 2025, topping the sale of 2024 Donruss Downtown Gold #15 Jim Kelly / Josh Allen PSA 10 Gem Mint that sold for $5,452 a month later.


### **1970 Topps Super Glossy**[O.J. Simpson](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=O.J.%20Simpson&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **Rookie Card (PSA 9) – $7,567**


Many of today’s collectors only know O.J. from his pop culture (and possibly criminal) exploits. However, back in the day he was a game-changing running back, earning him Hall of Fame honors years later. This rookie card commemorates his first year in the league, and sold for $7,567 in 2021.


### **1986 Topps**[Bruce Smith](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Bruce%20Smith&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **Rookie Card #389 (PSA 10) – $6,811**


Another Hall of Famer from the Bills’ early ‘90s run of Super Bowl appearances, Bruce Smith was an absolute monster on defense. His rookie card, which turned 40 this year, sold for $6,811 in December of 2025.


### **1998 Skybox Metal Universe Precious Metal Gems (PMG)**[Andre Reed](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Thurman%20Thomas&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **/50 (BGS 9)**


Unlike the other cards on this list, Andre Reed’s 1998 Skybox Metal Universe Precious Gems isn’t a rookie card. Even still, Reed is, like all the other players on this list, a Hall of Famer, and his gold jacket, combined with the sought after set, helped this card to sell for $4,300.


Other Bills stars that the Bills Mafia will want to track down are[Thurman Thomas](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Thurman%20Thomas&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , the formidable running back who starred for the Bills for 11 seasons, including their four trips to the Super Bowl, and[Stefon Diggs](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Stefon%20Diggs&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , the current wideout that is both loved and hated in Buffalo after leaving the team following four-straight 1,000-receiving-yard seasons.
